However, this equation is not exact because it does not take into account isotope fractionation. Fractionation occurs when one
isotope is discriminated against during a change in state (liquid to water vapor) or exchange between molecules (water to CO2). The
fractionation factor is <1 when the heavy isotope is discriminated against, ¼1 when there is no discrimination, or >1 when the light
isotope is discriminated against. At 37 C, the isotope fractionation factors are as follows: 0.946 for 2H and 0.991 for 18O between
liquid to water vapor and 1.038 for 18O between water and CO2.
